title: Malicious code in prettier-plugin-solidity-import-order (npm)
description: The npm package prettier-plugin-solidity-import-order contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may lead to exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system due to potential persistent control by an attacker.
